result.summary: The page renders largely as expected for a food delivery app. One minor styling inconsistency was found with the favorite (heart) icons.

issues.description: The favorite heart icons on the 'Popular right now' cards are inconsistent. The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a white heart outline with no background, while the pizza card below shows a heart inside a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon styling across all cards for a consistent look.
